title: CooperativeSessionPlan
description: A cooperative-coding session plan, as consumed by scripts/session_readiness.mjs's auditCoopSession().

teamSize.description: Number of humans participating in the session.

timezoneOverlapHours.description: Hours of working-day overlap shared by all participants.

voiceChannelTested.description: Whether the voice channel has been established and tested before the session (Quality Gate, sync/hybrid only).

workScopeSentence.description: The 1-sentence work scope, e.g. "We are implementing X feature with Y constraints."

fileOwnershipMapped.description: Whether file/directory ownership per person or agent has been mapped.

syncCadenceMinutes.description: Minutes between synchronization points (0 or omitted logically for pure async).

agentBoundariesSet.description: Whether it is defined which AI agent works where, and who reviews its output.

conflictResolutionOwner.description: Name/role of whoever breaks ties on technical decisions.

commitCadenceMinutes.description: Maximum minutes between commits during the session.

integrationTestedBeforeHandoff.description: Whether the code was verified to build/run before an async/hybrid handoff.
